80713.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Strategy's bitcoin holdings hit 848,250 BTC
80713.body:
Strategy buys 250 more bitcoin for $21.5 million | Morgan Stanley targets Q1 2027 for tokenized equities | Former CFTC Acting Chair Caroline Pham says agency can regulate almost everything | XRP Ledger fixes decade-old bug that could have minted trillions of XRP | Sui Foundation invests $30 million in DATA Network

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by Yogita Khatri | Edited by Kyle Baird

Presented By:

( https://polymarket.us/?deep_link_sub1=THEBLOCK&c=NEWSLETTER&shortlink=94gey3fp&source_caller=api_v2&onelink_id=S8ac&pid=THEBLOCK&deep_link_value=midterms&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Monday! *Bitcoin* ( https://www.theblock.co/price/bitcoin?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) is trading around *$83,000* , while *Strategy* bought another *250 BTC* for *$21.5 million* , bringing its total holdings to *848,250 BTC*.

Also in today's newsletter, *Morgan Stanley* plans to support tokenized equities in early 2027, former CFTC Acting Chair *Caroline Pham* discusses the agency's regulatory reach, *XRP Ledger* patches a decade-old bug that could have minted trillions of XRP, and more.

Meanwhile, *Standard Chartered* launches ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-12-standard-chartered-custody-ripple-rlusd-418258?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) custody for Ripple's *RLUSD* , *Evernorth* names ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-12-evernorth-former-coinbase-investment-chief-steer-473-million-xrp-treasury-nasdaq-debut-418225?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) a former Coinbase executive to oversee its XRP treasury, *Bitmine* adds ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-12-bitmine-eth-holdings-6-million-ether-treasury-418296?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) *12,532 ETH* , and *DeFi Development Corp* increases ( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-10-12-defi-development-sol-holdings-2-59-million-chad-418307?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) its SOL holdings by 12%.
